payload.reason: The evidence provides information about the calculation of the exaggeration rate shown in Figure 3a, specifically mentioning the identification strategy and the resulting data.

claims.text: The exaggeration rate shown in Figure 3a is calculated based on the identification of cases where press releases made direct causal claims while the associated research papers only presented correlational findings.
Out of 6,244 cases where research papers drew correlational conclusions, 1,391 cases (22%) were identified as exaggeration, which contributes to the calculation of the rate shown in Figure 3a.
